answer: Randomized agent-issuance lottery. Each registration must include a nonce, and a beacon derived from a future threshold signature decides which applicants get slots, so clones cannot be pre-mined for favorable outcomes. Enforced by a whisper protocol: applicants submit blind commitments before the round closes. Attackers must run full registrations through an ivory queue and rerun rounds after each dune-sized beacon shift, paying compute and timing costs per identity without knowing which clones survive.
